title: Irem Arcade Classics
native_title: アイレム・アーケード・クラシックス
overview:
The Excitement of the Arcade Comes Back to Life Right Here!

Irem Arcade Classics brings three Irem arcade games to one disc, for one or two players.

- 10-Yard Fight: A full-on American football game. Drive down the field for the touchdown, where the timing of your passes decides the play.
- Zippy Race: A high-speed motorcycle race across America from Los Angeles to the goal in New York. Weave through traffic, watch your fuel and show the cars who rules the road.
- Spartan X: Fighting action at its most basic. Battle your way up through five floors, taking down enemies with punches, jump kicks, foot sweeps and more.

ゲームセンターの興奮が、いまここに甦る!
